steps: Sign in on the web — the mobile apps have no cancel option
Account → Membership → Cancel Membership
Confirm. Access runs to the end of the period you have already paid for.
retention_tactics: May offer to pause your membership instead of cancelling
gotchas: If you signed up through Apple or Google, you must cancel there instead — Netflix cannot cancel it for you

steps: Sign in on the web at spotify.com/account
Under Your plan, choose Change plan, then Cancel Premium
Confirm. You keep Premium until the end of the current billing period, then drop to the free tier.
retention_tactics: May offer a discounted period to stay
gotchas: Cancelling does not delete your account, playlists or saved music
If billed through Apple, Google or a mobile network bundle, cancel with them instead

steps: Go to Your Account → Prime Membership
Choose Manage membership, then End membership
Work through the retention screens — there are several, and the option to continue cancelling is usually the least prominent button
Confirm on the final screen. Nothing is cancelled until you reach it.
retention_tactics: Multiple screens of benefits before the confirm button
May offer to pause or to switch to a cheaper plan
Offers to remind you before renewal instead of cancelling now
gotchas: A partial refund may be available if you have not used Prime benefits in the current period
Ending Prime also ends Prime Video, Prime Delivery and Prime Reading

steps: Sign in on the web and open Account → Subscription
Select your subscription, then Cancel Subscription
Give a reason if asked, then confirm. Access continues to the end of the paid period.
retention_tactics: May offer a cheaper ad-supported plan instead of cancelling
gotchas: If billed through Apple, Google, Sky or a broadband bundle, cancel with that provider

steps: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships while signed in
Select Manage membership, then Deactivate
Choose Continue to cancel. Benefits run to the end of the paid period.
retention_tactics: Offers to pause the membership for up to 6 months instead
gotchas: If you subscribed in the iOS app, it is billed by Apple and must be cancelled in iOS Settings

steps: Sign in at account.adobe.com and open Plans
Choose Manage plan, then Cancel your plan
Work through the retention offers
If the web flow will not complete, use live chat — it is often the only route that works
retention_tactics: Offers to switch you to a cheaper single-app plan
gotchas: An annual plan paid monthly usually carries an early termination fee of roughly half the remaining contract — check what you signed up to before cancelling
There is often a short window after renewal in which you can cancel without the fee

steps: Sign in on the web — the app does not offer cancellation
Account Details → Cancel membership
Decline the retention offers, which usually include a free month or a paused membership
Confirm on the final screen
retention_tactics: Offers to pause the membership for up to three months
Offers free credits or a discounted rate to stay
gotchas: Credits you have already bought are usually lost when the membership ends — spend them first
Books you have already purchased with credits remain yours

steps: Sign in at account.microsoft.com and open Services & subscriptions
Choose Manage on the subscription, then Cancel subscription
Confirm. You keep access until the end of the paid period.
retention_tactics: Offers to turn off recurring billing instead of cancelling outright
gotchas: Turning off recurring billing is not the same as cancelling, but it has the same practical effect at the end of the term
OneDrive storage drops back to the free allowance — move your files before the subscription lapses

steps: Open ChatGPT and go to Settings → Subscription
Choose Manage my subscription, then Cancel plan
Confirm. Access continues to the end of the paid month.
gotchas: If you subscribed in the iOS or Android app, cancel through Apple or Google instead

steps: Open claude.ai and go to Settings → Billing
Choose Manage subscription, then cancel
Confirm. Access continues to the end of the paid period.
gotchas: If you subscribed in a mobile app, cancel through Apple or Google instead

steps: On iPhone or iPad: Settings → your name at the top → iCloud → Manage Account Storage → Change Storage Plan
Choose Downgrade Options and sign in
Select the free 5GB plan, then Done
gotchas: If your data exceeds 5GB the extra is not deleted immediately, but new backups and syncing stop — get your photos off first
This is separate from other Apple subscriptions, which live under Settings → your name → Subscriptions

steps: Sign in to your online member account
Open your membership details and choose to cancel
Check the date your cancellation takes effect before you finish — it is usually the end of a notice period, not immediately
Cancel the Direct Debit with your bank only after the final payment has been taken, not before
retention_tactics: May offer a freeze or a cheaper off-peak membership instead
gotchas: Fixed-term memberships usually cannot be cancelled before the minimum term ends — check what you signed
Cancelling the Direct Debit first does not end the contract and can leave you owing arrears
Notice periods vary by membership type — confirm yours in your account before relying on 30 days

steps: Ring 150 from a Virgin Media line, or 0345 454 1111 from any phone
Ask explicitly to cancel — you will be transferred to a retentions team
State the date you want service to end and ask for written confirmation
If you cannot get through, write to the cancellations address on your bill; the notice period runs from the date they receive it
retention_tactics: Retentions will offer substantial discounts to keep you
May offer to reduce your package rather than cancel
gotchas: Cancelling inside a minimum term normally means early disconnection charges
You must return equipment or be charged for it — keep the proof of postage
Price rises during a contract may give you a right to leave without penalty; check the notice they sent you
